title: Lighthouse runtime and gateway stack in CDK
scenario: The helpdesk agent moves from a hand-built pilot to a pipeline-deployable CDK app: one scanned, immutable image in shared-services ECR; AgentCore Runtime per account in an isolated VPC with endpoints; versioned endpoints for rollback; and the user directory reachable only as a Gateway MCP tool behind a JWT authorizer. Synth is offline; aws-cdk-lib/assertions grades it.
task: Fail-fast env and imageTag context; config-driven stacks
Immutable scanned repo with lifecycle and pull-only cross-account policy
Runtime with least-privilege role, VPC mode and pinned endpoints
Isolated VPC with interface endpoints; JWT gateway with a Lambda target
A CDK Aspect that rejects wildcard IAM actions
acceptance: Template assertions pass for dev and prod
Aspect flags wildcards; your stacks have no errors
ANSWER.md covers fromEcrRepository vs fromAsset and endpoint rollback

practices.label: Week 3 Mon - Runtime contract and ARM64 images
Week 3 Tue - CDK L2 constructs, versions and endpoints
Week 3 Wed - Gateway targets and inbound auth
Week 3 Thu - VPC endpoints for Bedrock and AgentCore
